article.title: 案例補讀：Zocdoc向AI代理開放美國醫療預約接入
article.title_en: Case review: Zocdoc welcomes AI agents for US appointment bookings
article.summary: Zocdoc於10月28日宣布向AI代理開放預約基建，並與Instinct合作。
article.summary_en: Zocdoc announced agent access and an Instinct partnership on October 28.
highlights: 代理可查詢醫生、保險及可預約時段。
預約前須取得病人明確同意。
highlights_en: Agents can check providers, insurance and availability.
Explicit patient consent is required before booking.
article.why: 服務品牌可參考其把資料查詢與可確認交易分開處理的方式。
article.why_en: Service brands can study the separation of discovery from confirmed transactions.
article.next_step: 盤點預約資料與授權步驟，先評估代理可讀及可執行的界線。
article.next_step_en: Map booking data and consent before defining agent permissions.
article.detail: 這項美國案例提供了從AI查詢走向預約的具體接入方式。Zocdoc列出MCP伺服器、REST API及深層連結，供代理連接服務；MCP是讓AI與外部工具交換資料的協定。合作方Instinct將透過MCP接入。公告要求代理登記身份、保護資料及取得預約同意。服務只涵蓋美國，不能據此推斷香港可用或醫療結果有所改善。
article.detail_en: Zocdoc lists an MCP server, REST API and deep links. MCP connects AI to external tools; Instinct will use it. Agents must identify themselves and protect data. Coverage is US-only; no Hong Kong access or clinical improvement is established.
